payload.posture: Read 1 Maccabees 4:36–59 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states victory is followed by inspection, demolition of the defiled altar, new vessels, restored offerings, and an annual feast. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
